description: The adidas Yeezy Quantum ‘Amber Tint’ adds streaks of color to an otherwise neutral colorway of Kane West’s basketball-inspired silhouette. Complementary gold, bronze and brown tones are applied to wavy synthetic overlays on a semi-translucent mesh upper. The ventilated construction is equipped with a grey synthetic suede toe cap and a stretchy black neoprene collar and tongue. A molded heel counter cradles the back of the foot. Responsive cushioning arrives via a full-length Boost midsole, enveloped in a durable TPU cage and supported by a herringbone-traction rubber outsole.
